cards.design_implication: If a study design targets backend-of-line integration of 2D materials, the protocol may be scoped to 100-mm wafer formats and adhesive bonding techniques compatible with existing manufacturing lines.
does_not_establish: Eligibility criteria for participants or samples
Statistical analysis plans or bias controls
Causal mechanisms underlying the bonding process beyond the description of the methodology
cards.evidence_excerpt: Here, we report a generic methodology for large-area integration of 2D materials by adhesive wafer bonding. Our approach avoids manual handling and uses equipment, processes, and materials that are readily available in large-scale semiconductor manufacturing lines.
limitations: The text explicitly states current approaches are not compatible with high-volume manufacturing, implying the reported method is a proposed solution rather than a universally adopted standard.
The demonstration is limited to specific material combinations (CVD graphene, MoS2, hBN) and specific wafer sizes (100-mm).
cards.statement: The reported methodology for integrating 2D materials involves adhesive wafer bonding using equipment available in large-scale semiconductor lines, demonstrated on 100-mm diameter silicon wafers.

cards.design_implication: If measuring device performance in similar 2D material heterostructures, carrier mobility can serve as a quantifiable endpoint for assessing integration quality, with 4520 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ representing a reported upper bound in this context.
does_not_establish: Measurement calibration standards or instrument settings
Comparison against control groups or benchmark devices
Statistical significance of the reported mobility values
Generalizability to materials other than graphene or MoS2
cards.evidence_excerpt: fabricate encapsulated field-effect graphene devices, with high carrier mobilities of up to $$4520\;{\mathrm{cm}}^2{\mathrm{V}}^{ - 1}{\mathrm{s}}^{ - 1}$$ 4520 cm 2 V − 1 s − 1
limitations: The value is stated as 'up to', indicating a maximum observed value rather than a mean or median.
Sample size and statistical distribution of the mobility measurements are not provided in the abstract.
cards.statement: Encapsulated field-effect graphene devices fabricated via this method exhibited high carrier mobilities of up to 4520 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹.
